thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate on /v1/generate in hosted-west. 95%ile latency > 5s and 5xx spike. Triggered at 14:02 UTC.
Kai (oncall): I'm on it, joining the bridge.
Triage Bot: Bridge created -> https://meet.redwood/incident/2227009999 (auto)
Mira (sre): Observed sudden CPU steal on node pool g-infer-west-2 starting ~14:00, autoscaler tried to add pods but failed with `ImagePullBackOff`.
DevOps Jen: Looking at ECR auth errors on hosts; token refresh to ECR failed during rotation window.
Paul (infra): Confirmed, several hosts couldn't pull the new runtime image. KMS returned 403 for a subset of worker instances.
Kai (oncall): OK mitigate: rolling restart of puller agents and fallback to cached container image. Who can run `kubectl rollout` in hosted-west?
Sam (eng): I can do the rollout commands. Patching deployment with `imagePolicy: cached` now.
Mira (sre): Quick mitigation applied, routing switched to cached image for new pods. Latency and 5xx dropping.
Lia (product): Any customer impact? Any paid customers hit 5xx for >30s?
Kai (oncall): Preliminary: small fraction of requests saw 5xx between 14:01-14:07. No major SLO burns but two high-volume orgs saw increased tail latency; sending emails now.
DevOps Jen: Auth rotation logs show an edge case where token refresh failed when the KMS endpoint returned 503 during regional maintenance. Ops ticket with cloud provider opened.
 Paul (infra): Remediation: switched hosts to nodepool with older kubelet that doesn't hit the auth bug. Creating tracker for permanent fix.
Kai (oncall): Action items we need to track: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) update on-call runbook for image-pull fallback, 3) test ECR/KMS rotation in staging, 4) customer notification follow-up. Assign owners?
Mira (sre): I'll take #2 and #3.
Sam (eng): I'll take #1 (write timeline/impact) and help with logs.
Paul (infra): I'll take cloud provider follow-up and the nodepool migration plan (new ticket #INC-4527).
Lia (product): I'll own customer comms and coordinate with CS; will draft updates for the two orgs and the status page.
Kai (oncall): Cool. Let's schedule postmortem in 48h to give teams time to collect logs. Who's available Monday 16:00 UTC?
Mira (sre): I'm free.
Paul (infra): free.
Sam (eng): can do.
Lia (product): yes.
Kai (oncall): Booked postmortem for Mon 16:00 UTC in #postmortems and add to calendar.
Triage Bot: Postmortem draft created -> https://docs.redwood/postmortems/2227009999 (auto).
Sam (eng): Will start a timeline in the doc and paste relevant `kubectl` outputs and `journalctl` snippets.
Mira (sre): Runbook note: current on-call playbook assumes cached images are always populated. We should add step to proactively seed caches before rotation windows. Adding to runbook doc now.
DevOps Jen: Also add a check to CI that validates KMS token refresh path during the deploy window.
Paul (infra): FYI I found one host with expired CA in the rotation agent; replacing cert and kicking the instance off the pool resolved the `ImagePullBackOff` on that host specifically.
Kai (oncall): Customer impact summary for the postmortem: brief spike in errors, no sustained outage, two orgs saw elevated latencies for ~6 minutes. Lia will send targeted messages, ops to prepare status page blurb.
Lia (product): Drafting messages; will ping for review in the doc.
Sam (eng): Quick note for the timeline: 14:00 - KMS regional maintenance started; 14:01 - first `ImagePullBackOff` observed; 14:02 - Pager triggered; 14:04 - mitigation applied (cached image route); 14:07 - error rates back to baseline.
Kai (oncall): Assigning follow-ups in the tracker: `INC-4527` owner Paul, `PMT-2227` postmortem Sam, `RUN-558` runbook edits Mira, `CUST-889` customer comms Lia. Please add links to PRs/patches in those tickets.
Mira (sre): I'll open the PR for runbook edits and include the seeding play and a small test script for `docker pull` retries.
DevOps Jen: I'll add a CI check prototype and mark as draft in the infra repo.
Kai (oncall): Anything else before I close the pager?
Paul (infra): Reminder: we should add an automated synthetic that pulls runtime image from ECR every 5m during rotation windows. I'll prototype.
Lia (product): Also recommend we add a short customer-facing FAQ line about transient errors during deploy rotations. I'll draft.
Kai (oncall): OK closing pager but leaving incident open for postmortem tasks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident severity auto-updated -> SEV3 (customer impact limited). Pager closed at 14:15 UTC.
Sam (eng): Will update the postmortem doc with logs and assign reviewers by EOD.
Mira (sre): Runbook PR incoming.
DevOps Jen: CI check PR soon.
Paul (infra): Nodepool migration plan ticket linked to INC-4527.
Lia (product): Customer messages queued, will send after you approve the draft in the doc.
Kai (oncall): Great work everyone. Reminder to link all artifacts to the postmortem doc before Monday review.
